description: The `guard-seats` test group (research/notes/factory-guard-plan.md): the human seat's finished ARMVP at the pinned camera centre, six ARMCK and two ARMCV guarding it from a line north of it, metal and energy to spare. The test group selects the plant with a native click and queues Flashes through its build panel; the builders walk to their seats, help every Flash from there without a step, and the Flashes leave by the plant's lane. Two ARMCV beside the ARMCK, so the seats hold two footprints and two reaches.
